verdict.rationale: Vercel's REST API documentation shows versioned endpoint paths, such as /v6/deployments and /v3/deployments/{idOrUrl}/events, so endpoints carry explicit version numbers. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or version-lifecycle guarantees, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version sunset/notice timelines, independent corroboration of versioning stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: To access resources owned by a team, append the Team ID as a query string: https://api.vercel.com/v6/deployments?teamId=[teamID]
